title: qlcog: quantum-like, quantum and quantum-inspired models with classical baselines, Qiskit circuits and a Bloch-sphere viewer
description: Python library for quantum-like models of human judgement, decision and trust (each with classical baselines), quantum machine learning and algorithms as Qiskit circuits, quantum-inspired optimisers and tensor networks, shared QUBO problems and a 3D Bloch-sphere viewer. Built for robots and AI agents that work with people.
